newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS - Metro shares soar as it eyes Makro.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Metro shares soar as it eyes Makro.

text.p: Retail group Metro AG and its majority shareholder Metro Holding AG said on Monday they were in talks with the Dutch retailer SHV Holdings NV about taking over its cash and carry business, the Utrecht-based Makro.
"The negotiations are to be concluded as soon as possible," Metro said in a statement.
Shares in Metro AG soared on the news. The share was quoted 8.70 marks, or 4.25 percent higher, at 204.80 marks on the Frankfurt bourse.
Traders said news of the planned acquisition was the clear reason for the price gains, which far outstripped the market. The DAX was trading around 0.4 percent higher in morning trade.
"Metro is firmer following news of this takeover," one trader at a German bank said.
The talks concern two sets of business.

The first is Makro businesses with a total of 86 cash and carry outlets in Britain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Greece, the Czech Republic and Morocco with sales expected to reach 16 billion marks ($9.2 billion) this year. Metro Holding already owns 40 percent of these businesses.

The second concerns companies in which SHV and Makro own minority stakes in cash and carry businesses owned by Metro Holding in Denmark, Austria, Italy, France, Hungary and Turkey with sales this year expected to reach 13.6 billion marks.
